title: WHERE with numbers: AND, OR, BETWEEN
explanation: So far you've shown every row. WHERE lets you keep only the rows you want, like a filter. It goes after FROM. You compare numbers with symbols: = (equals), > (more than), < (less than), >= (at least), <= (at most), and != (not equal). Use AND when BOTH things must be true, and OR when EITHER one is enough. BETWEEN 10 AND 20 is a shortcut for 'from 10 up to 20', and it includes both ends.

lines.explain: Show me the title and price columns.
Only keep rows where the price is more than 50. Every other row is filtered out.

tasks.prompt: Show the title and price of games that cost less than 30.
tasks.answer: SELECT title, price FROM games WHERE price < 30;
hints: You need a WHERE line after FROM.
Use the less-than symbol: WHERE price < 30

solution_lines.explain: Show me the title and price columns.
Only keep games where the price is less than 30.

tasks.prompt: Show the title of every free game.
tasks.answer: SELECT title FROM games WHERE price = 0;
hints: What price does a free game have?
A free game costs 0, so use WHERE price = 0

solution_lines.explain: Only keep games where the price equals 0, meaning free.

tasks.prompt: Show the title and rating of games with a rating above 9.5 AND a price under 60.
tasks.answer: SELECT title, rating FROM games WHERE rating > 9.5 AND price < 60;
hints: Both conditions must be true, so join them with AND.

solution_lines.explain: Show me the title and rating columns.
Keep a game only if BOTH are true: rating above 9.5, and price under 60.

tasks.prompt: Show the title and release year of games released from 2015 to 2018 (including both years).
tasks.answer: SELECT title, release_year FROM games WHERE release_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2018;
hints: There's a shortcut for 'from one number to another'.

solution_lines.explain: Show me the title and release year columns.
Keep games released from 2015 up to 2018. BETWEEN includes both ends.

tasks.prompt: Show each genre only once for games that are free OR came out before 2012.
tasks.answer: SELECT DISTINCT genre FROM games WHERE price = 0 OR release_year < 2012;
hints: Remember DISTINCT from Lesson 1? And either condition is enough here, so use OR.
SELECT DISTINCT genre ... WHERE price = 0 OR release_year < 2012

solution_lines.explain: Show me the genre column, with no repeats.
Keep a game if EITHER is true: it's free, or it came out before 2012.

recap: You just learned to filter rows with WHERE, compare numbers with symbols like > and <, combine conditions with AND and OR, and use BETWEEN for ranges.
